sections.after: Is it safe to travel to China right now?
sections.title: US citizens: who should read the advisory especially carefully?
items: Level 2 is not Level 3, Reconsider Travel, or Level 4, Do Not Travel. It means travelers should understand the named risks, read the complete current advisory, and prepare accordingly.

The advisory identifies additional concerns for people involved in business or family disputes, research, journalism, government-funded programs, and current or former government, military, law-enforcement, or intelligence work.

US citizens of Chinese heritage, former Chinese citizens, dual nationals, and travelers using Chinese-issued identity or travel documents should read the nationality and consular-assistance sections closely.
A leisure tourist does not automatically share every higher-risk circumstance, but no online guide can assess an individual's legal, professional, family, or personal exposure.

sections.after: US citizens: who should read the advisory especially carefully?
sections.title: Before a US citizen travels to China
items: Read the current US Department of State China Travel Advisory and China country information again shortly before departure because wording and risk levels can change.
Consider enrolling in the free Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) to receive embassy or consulate alerts and make emergency contact easier.
Discuss business disputes, dual-nationality questions, prior government work, journalism, research, or other higher-risk circumstances with an appropriate official or qualified adviser before travel.
For detention, a lost passport, a serious dispute, or another consular emergency, contact the nearest US embassy or consulate and follow its current instructions.

faqs.after: Is it safe to travel to China in 2026?
faqs.question: Is China safe for US citizens in 2026?
faqs.answer: Many US citizens visit without serious incidents. The current US advisory is Level 2, Exercise Increased Caution, because of arbitrary enforcement of local laws, exit-ban risks, and the risk of unjust arrest or detention. Read the full current advisory, consider your individual circumstances, and follow local laws.

faqs.after: Is China safe for solo female travelers?
faqs.question: Is China safe for children and families?
faqs.answer: China can be practical for family travel. Plan for crowds, carry medicine and hotel details, use child-appropriate restraints where available, and agree on a meeting point.

sections.title: First identify why check-in was refused

headers: What it means for your next step
rows: “We cannot accept foreigners” or “we lack foreign-related qualification”
Ask a manager to review the booking and foreign-passport registration process. Save the reason in writing and contact the booking platform if the property will not reconsider.
No room or the hotel is overbooked
Treat this as a failure to honor the reservation, not automatically as nationality discrimination. Ask the hotel or platform for immediate relocation and any refund due under the booking terms.
Name, passport, guest count, date, or room details do not match
Compare the reservation with every guest’s original passport and correct the mismatch through the booking platform before arguing about foreign-guest policy.
Payment, deposit, late arrival, or property-rule problem
Ask for the exact charge, deadline, or rule in writing. Check the reservation terms and use a prepared payment method or platform support where appropriate.

items: Do not assume every refusal has the same legal or practical cause. The written reason determines whether the fastest solution is manager review, booking correction, relocation, or a refund request.

sections.after: If a hotel refuses your passport at the desk
sections.title: Short messages to copy and show
items: 请告诉我无法办理入住的具体原因。是订单、房态，还是外国护照登记问题？ — Please tell me the specific reason check-in cannot be completed. Is it the booking, room availability, or foreign-passport registration?
这是我的预订确认和护照。请让值班经理帮忙处理。 — Here are my booking confirmation and passport. Please ask the duty manager to help.
请在预订平台的消息里写明拒绝入住的原因。 — Please state the reason for refusing check-in in the booking-platform message.
如果酒店无法履行订单，请帮我免费改订到安全的同等住宿。 — If the hotel cannot honor the booking, please relocate me to safe, equivalent accommodation without an extra charge.
如果无法改订，请在平台上确认取消和退款。 — If relocation is not possible, please confirm the cancellation and refund through the platform.

sections.after: Short messages to copy and show
sections.title: Evidence to save for relocation or refund support
items: The reservation number, exact property and branch, booked dates, room type, guest names, payment status, cancellation terms, and the original listing.
Platform messages showing any pre-arrival confirmation that the property could check in the passport holders on the reservation.
A written platform or hotel message stating the refusal reason, plus the time of arrival and the role of the staff member or manager you spoke with.
Receipts for prepaid accommodation, replacement lodging, and necessary transport to the replacement property.
Screenshots of platform support conversations and the final relocation, cancellation, or refund decision. Do not publish staff or guest personal information.

sections.after: Evidence to save for relocation or refund support
sections.title: How to ask the booking platform for help
items: Open support from the exact reservation so the agent can see the property, payment, cancellation conditions, and previous messages.
State the immediate need clearly: confirmed guest refused at check-in, exact reason given, current local time, and whether safe accommodation is needed tonight.
Request relocation to comparable safe accommodation before accepting a cancellation that leaves you without a room. Ask who pays any price difference and transport.
If relocation is unavailable, request the refund or cancellation remedy supported by the reservation terms and the platform’s failure-to-honor process.

Keep the case number and written outcome. A refund route is a booking and payment matter; the NIA 12367 hotline is for immigration and accommodation-registration guidance, not platform refund decisions.

faqs.after: What should I do if a hotel refuses me at check-in?
faqs.question: What should I do if I am refused late at night?
faqs.answer: Prioritize a safe staffed replacement rather than a prolonged front-desk dispute. Ask the booking platform for immediate relocation, confirm who covers any price difference and transport, and keep the original booking, refusal message, replacement receipt, and support case number.

faqs.after: What should I do if I am refused late at night?
faqs.question: What evidence should I keep for a hotel refund request?
faqs.answer: Keep the reservation, payment and cancellation terms, written passport check-in confirmation, refusal reason, platform messages, case number, and receipts for replacement lodging and necessary transport. Ask the hotel or platform to record the decision in writing.

faqs.after: What evidence should I keep for a hotel refund request?
faqs.question: Can 12367 arrange my hotel refund?
faqs.answer: 12367 provides National Immigration Administration guidance, including accommodation-registration questions. Refunds, relocation, and failure-to-honor remedies should be handled with the hotel and booking platform under the reservation terms.

sections.title: Useful apps after landing
items: Meituan for food delivery and local services where its interface and payment route are practical for you.
Official city metro apps, mini-programs, or station maps for line and exit planning.
The city transport code inside Alipay for local bus or metro rides where your city supports it; it is different from the merchant payment QR.
Your eSIM provider's app or account page, with setup and support instructions saved offline.

faqs.after: Do I need a Chinese phone number for every app?
faqs.question: Can I use Uber in China?
faqs.answer: Uber is not the standard ride-hailing option in mainland China. Use DiDi, a ride-hailing service inside Alipay or WeChat, or an official taxi queue.
